title: Genie One enhancements
body:
* **Ontology snippets now available to all customers (Public Preview)**: Ontology snippets in the Genie Ontology are now available to all customers. Customers no longer need to request access. See [Genie Ontology](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#ontology).
* **Workspace instructions (GA)**: Workspace-level instructions for chat in Genie One are now generally available. See [Add workspace instructions for chat](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#workspace-instructions).
* **Upload images and Word documents**: Genie One now supports uploading images (PNG, JPG, and JPEG) and Word (`.docx`) files to a conversation, in addition to CSV and Excel files. See [Upload a file](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#upload-a-file).
* **MCP writes (Beta)**: Genie One now supports MCP writes, so connected MCP tools can perform write actions. See [Connect to external tools and sources](/aws/en/genie-one/external-sources).
* **PDF attachments for scheduled tasks**: Scheduled tasks can now send their results as a PDF email attachment. See [Scheduled tasks](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#scheduled-tasks).
* **Updated Genie Agents terminology**: References to "Genie spaces" that remained in the Genie One interface now use the current Genie Agents terminology.
